sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Set of keys missing. Ops Phone battery low — standby to recharge before commencing patrols.
Ops Phone at 58%, now on patrols. Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street maintaining security presence.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street, area thoroughly cleared, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, no issues present.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed with no vagrants or issues identified.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, a few street vagrants present but no concerns identified.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep completed with welfare checks on all stores and businesses open at this hour, all clear.
Continuing patrols, no activities requiring assistance.
Welfare check at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Federal Square and The Cathedral Church, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Hollywood Cafe, all clear.
Welfare check at Little Albert's Cafe and The People's Barista, all clear.
Check-in at top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced on all stores in the area, all clear. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart — group of street vagrants yelling and consuming alcohol in public.

Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; advised those consuming alcohol to keep it discreet and out of public view, noted the noise complaints, and asked them to uphold the peace and be respectful of the public.
Response call from Auckland Harbour Suites — verbally aggressive male inside the lobby. Advised of a slight delay due to the McDonald's Britomart incident.

Response call from the building manager at Auckland Harbour Suites — very aggressive male inside, verbally insulting staff and not complying with hotel policies. Advised them to call police immediately.
Team split into two: one guard dealing with the McDonald's Britomart incident, the other en route to Auckland Harbour Suites.
Arrived at Auckland Harbour Suites; police notified and now present on scene. Standing by to maintain visible presence. (Video footage captured on bodycam.)
Response message from Hollywood Cafe, Wyndham Street — male individual committed theft, stealing several pies and food items. Posted to Auror. (Video on file.)
Advised management to seek a trespass notice.
Trespass notice retrieved and lodged in the police system, valid for 2 years as of today (posted to Auror). Police have left; presence will remain stationed until the POI and his family leave.
Continuing patrols to next checkpoint. Ending Alpha Route.
Check-in at bottom of Fort Street, welfare checks on all stores and businesses, all clear. Brief standby to maintain presence.
Check-in at Wilson's Carpark, Fort Street; scoped the area and completed welfare checks on all stores and static guards present, all clear.
Patrolling up High Street. Welfare checks at Vulcan Lane and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, no issues, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square, full sweep completed ensuring no vagrants or trouble visible, all clear. Standby to maintain presence and await response calls.
Continuing patrols up High Street, welfare checks on remaining stores and businesses.
Welfare checks commenced along Lorne Street, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Nandos, Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Check-in at top of Mayoral Drive, full scope of the area, all clear.
Response call from management requesting a follow-up check on Liquor City; reported they have been getting hit lately.

Arrived and spoke with Liquor City; they feel unsafe due to frequent theft since the CRL train station opened. Advised we will maintain a strong nearby presence and conduct frequent follow-up checks to deter further issues. (Posted to Auror.)
Response call from Typo — male individual stole a bag and left without purchasing, last seen heading down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Typo, retrieved a photo description of the person of interest (posted to Auror). Patrolling down Queen Street searching for the offender.
Unsuccessful search; cut through Vulcan Lane to a possible hotspot (Freyberg Place). None identified.
Response call from management requesting assistance back at HQ.
Arrived at HQ, standby for management. Heading to welfare and follow-up checks on Victoria Street stores, maintaining presence and awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols, making way to HQ for lunch break and to write up reports for today's incidents.
Arrived at HQ, taking lunch break, awaiting further response calls.
Break completed; standby to write up reports and prepare for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Equipment handover: 2 x Radios, 2 x Keycards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Operations Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Notes: follow-up checks on Auckland Harbour Suites; follow-up check and standby at Liquor City, Victoria Street; find the set of keys for building checks.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. Set of keys missing.
Debrief with morning shift regarding the status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street (HQ). Welfare checks, all clear:
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, full sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed, all clear.
Walkthrough of Bledisloe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, Elliott Street Apartment, Atrium on Elliott, Elliott Food Court.
Welfare check through Elliott Street buildings and Elliott Stables, all clear.
Heading back to collect survey physical copies from stores on the corner of Mayoral Drive and Queen Street.
Walkthrough of Bledisloe building alleyway behind Skyworld.
Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, all clear.
Welfare check through Auckland Town Hall back way.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive to conduct collection of survey forms.
Collecting physical survey forms from stores (corner of Mayoral Drive / Queen Street, Elliott Stables and lower Queen Street):
Bird on a Wire — not completed
Cleaning staff inside Stables — not completed
Bag Planet / Mobile Planet — not completed
Celine Mediterranean Cuisine — filled (staff who filled not present)
Recycle Boutique — staff who filled not in store
Cotton On — staff who filled not in store
Mecca / Farmers — staff who have form not in store
Management calling the manager on duty last week to confirm forms.
Heading with management (Hasi) to Hour Glass to discuss trespass issues.
Awaiting at Level 7 for trespass forms to be printed.
Walking back with management (Hasi) to Hour Glass.
Hour Glass manager has filled the trespass form.
Trespass form completed by guards; standing by in case the individual returns.
While on standby, the male individual (Graham) approached and was issued the trespass. He accepted and walked away. (Video on file.)
Commencing routes again. Most stores closed for trading apart from a few retail stores, convenience stores and McDonald's franchises.
Noticed a female individual in a building doorway; asked her to leave, she complied.
Welfare check at Cotton On, Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, Ms Higgins, Timezone, ChaPanda, Chating, all clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived back at HQ; Ops Phone about to die (1%).
Standby to charge Ops Phone before resuming routes.
Response call from Ace Karaoke requesting standby until a guard arrives to start at 20:00.
Standing by at Ace Karaoke on management's request.
Still standing by at Ace Karaoke.
Standby guard starting; leaving Ace Karaoke.
Welfare check at Good To Go Supermarket, all clear.
Welfare check at Skymart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Scrunchy Miller's, City Liquor, all clear.
Welfare check at Tandoor, Domino's Pizza, Freshmarket, all clear.
Welfare check at Pizza Club Elliott Street, Wilson Carpark food stalls, all clear.
Welfare check at Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, all clear.
Welfare check at Avachi, Hulucat, Bahn-mi King, Subway, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Midcity Arcade, all clear.
Welfare check up Queen Street towards Aotea Square, all clear.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Sumthin Dumpling, Chongcha, all clear.
Welfare check at Uncle Mann, Red Radisson, all clear.
Standing by at Lorne Street fountain.
Response call from Jo&Joe regarding an individual bothering staff and customers; assistance requested.
En route to the call, received a message to stand down — individual has left.
Welfare check at BBQ Grill Planet, Chill Saigon, Plus Chicken, Cocomo, Paskatsu, Fresh Meet, all clear.
Welfare check at Dumpling House, Puffing Kiwi, Sail City Convenience Store, all clear.
Standing by on Queen Street to show presence while remaining vigilant for response calls.
Lunch break completed; standby for changeover to Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Heading out on patrols, phone at 41%. Commencing Alpha Route.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report.
Patrolling upper Queen Street heading towards Aotea Square.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear. Heading back down Queen Street for a full sweep.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues.
Check-in at The Hour Glass, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store, no issues. Queen Street full sweep complete, all clear — a few vagrants sleeping but causing no issues.
Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, conducting full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare checks with Danny's / marina guards, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke on standby, showing security presence due to a rugby team on the premises.
Still on standby at Ace Karaoke, team still inside; standby for assistance and security presence.
No issues at Ace Karaoke; heading over to Federal Street.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Responded to a call from Queen Street McDonald's — individual yelling and talking to herself.
Arrived on site; POI had already left but staff advised she comes in and out. Standby showing presence.
No sign of POI; continuing patrol of Queen Street.
Check-in at The Hour Glass, all clear — no one in front of the store, just a vagrant sleeping in front of Mirrou; no issues to report.
Wyndham Street all clear; check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Jo and Joe's, no issues; Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues.

Responding to a call from Queen Street McDonald's. 04:07 arrived on site, asked the individual to leave; POI complied (same POI that leaves and returns). Standby at Queen Street McDonald's for security presence.
An argument between two male individuals outside Queen Street McDonald's; a fight almost broke out but, with our presence, we de-escalated and separated the two parties. No further issues to report.
All clear at Queen Street McDonald's, no further issues. Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
Break ended. On standby charging Ops Phone, staying vigilant and ready to respond.
